selection_policy: Do not exclude candidates for inactivity in individual historical windows. Rank completed candidates by after-cost return and downside metrics; report trade coverage as a diagnostic rather than a selection constraint. Never rank by trade frequency or overwrite selected_strategies.json automatically.

joint_diagnostic_period.role: Latest known 20-calendar-day diagnostic period before October; not an untouched validation period after redesign.

sizing_comparison_period.role: Pre-October rolling-window sensitivity comparison after enough STI history exists for sizing; September is already known and this is not untouched validation.
